engine: SQLite STRICT ANY compound result exported by BookieE; LibreOffice Calc on Debian testing
case: Formula-shaped text stays text through BookieE XLSX output and LibreOffice Calc ODS/XLSX re-save
contract: The compound result contains integer 42, text 42, SQL NULL, formula-shaped text =1+1, and formula-shaped text '=1+1; native typeof() labels identify the runtime kind for every row.
BookieE emits integer 42 as a numeric XLSX cell, text values as shared strings, and SQL NULL as a blank cell. The XLSX contains no formula elements.
LibreOffice Calc opens the workbook and saves ODS, then reopens ODS and saves XLSX. The formula-shaped text values remain strings in both formats, and Calc creates no formulas.
The integer, numeric-looking text and blank NULL keep their respective kinds through the same Calc round trip.

bookiee_export.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=<evidence-dir>/source.xlsx cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-app --lib ui::browse_tab::value_parse::sqlite_any_contract::sqlite_compound_any_result_exports_csv_text_and_xlsx_cell_kinds -- --exact --test-threads=1

steps: Open source.xlsx with LibreOffice Calc and save as calc-roundtrip.ods.
Reopen calc-roundtrip.ods with LibreOffice Calc and save as calc-roundtrip.xlsx.

consumer_assertions.method: Python standard-library ZIP/XML checks over ODS content.xml and XLSX worksheet/shared strings; assert exact values and cell kinds, blank NULL, and no formula elements.

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other spreadsheet applications and versions, workbook shapes, broader format combinations and installed GTK grid editing remain open in B3/B7.
